reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 2 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nuggets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 59 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 205 and 254 total points.
